remarks: Set within the desirable Glen Arthur Estates community in Stamford's Glenbrook neighborhood, this detached Colonial-style condominium offers a wonderful blend of comfort, space, and convenience. This cheerful and well-maintained home features inviting sun-filled living spaces with hardwood floors throughout both the first and second levels. The living room includes a gas fireplace and a striking Palladian window, while the eat-in kitchen is enhanced by a vaulted ceiling and skylight.  Upstairs, the home offers three bedrooms and two full baths, all complemented by hardwood flooring. The finished lower level provides flexible space for a family room, home office, guest area, or additional living needs. Outside, enjoy a private patio and a beautifully landscaped garden setting, ideal for relaxing, entertaining, or outdoor dining. Perfectly positioned near shopping, restaurants, public transportation, and bus lines, and within walking distance to the Glenbrook railroad station with easy access to I-95 and the Merritt Parkway, this home offers both neighborhood charm and commuter-friendly convenience.  Recent improvements over the past five years include: new roof, window replacement, new A/C compressor, new boiler and hot water tank, installation of hardwood flooring on the second level, remodeled primary bathroom, all new kitchen appliances, new washer and dryer, mature backyard garden, mature front yard garden, and an underground sprinkler and drip irrigation system.
